items.question: Did Lucy Olsen transfer from Villanova to Iowa?
items.answer: Yes. Lucy Olsen played three seasons at Villanova, where she scored 1,504 points and averaged 23.3 points as a junior, third in the country. She signed with Iowa in April 2024 and was a unanimous All-Big Ten First Team pick in 2024-25, averaging 17.9 points and 5.1 assists.

items.question: Did Lucy Olsen play for the Townsville Fire?
items.answer: Yes. Lucy Olsen played in Australia's WNBL for the Townsville Fire, averaging 8.7 points and 3.4 assists in 28 games. She won the league's Sixth Woman of the Year award and helped Townsville win the WNBL title.
